title: What It Actually Looks Like to Want a Wife and Not Need One
caption:
Wanting a wife is not the problem. God said it before sin ever entered the story: it is not good for man to be alone. That desire is a good one, put there on purpose.

Needing her is a different thing. Needing her to end the loneliness, prove your worth, finish what only God finishes. It shows up before she ever answers the text, and she feels the weight before either of you can name it.

So chase God first. Pray for your future wife before you've met her. Build the man now instead of waiting on her to build him for you. Get your own house in order and let prayer carry the ache, not the group chat.

Here's how you know it's working: you're at peace either way, and it's not performed. Your worth was never staked on being chosen by her. It was staked on being chosen by Christ.

Want a wife. Need God. That's the man worth marrying.

theme: He chases God, not a wife.
